pages.text: The forest of Hell: towering $(l)hellwood trees$() with buttress roots and burning canopies, tall $(item)Hellferns$(), waves of $(item)Blazing Grass$() and long glowing $(item)Ember Vines$() hanging from the ceiling (climbable).$(br2)Creatures: Ember Stalkers, Fire Ghasts, plenty of Cinder Hens and Ember Cows.
pages.title: Jungle infernale
